smn_misc.note: Memory clear status the ABL polls with no timeout: bit 1 must read set after the start write (bit 0). Constant bit 1 satisfies it; real semantics unconfirmed.
Console enable the ABL reads in init_console_config: bit 9 set opens the UART print sink (static read); bit 8 stays clear because it stalls a breakpoint handshake. Real semantics unconfirmed.

Environment marker the ABL reads; 0xb1aab1aa and 0x4e554e55/0x51e051e0 mean simulation/emulation, any other value means real silicon. Looks like a mailbox an external debug script writes, 0 on hardware (the value is certain to be no marker, exact 0 is a guess).
Platform strap, bits 4:2 = 4 (socket SP3 by the ABL's use of the field); the generic value is the Zen2 one.
CPUID-EAX style family/model word the ABL checks before the APCB table lookups (bits 27:20 = 0xa, 11:8 = 0xf, 19:16 = 0); the stepping nibble is a guess.

64-bit word (0x30000808 low, 0x3000080c high) the MP5 command handler of the Zen3 off-chip BL clears bit 20 of; read/write-back storage with bit 20 set at reset so the clear is observable. Real semantics unconfirmed.
High half of the 64-bit word at 0x30000808; read/write-back storage.

CCD presence mask byte the off-chip BL reads for die 0; one CCD set. Workaround: on the real boot path the CCD step that reads it is skipped, our run takes it, so a non-zero mask avoids post code 0x35.

ram_windows.note: AXI window the off-chip BL maps for die 0 (1 MiB): it stages the BL public key here (0x1800 bytes) and the MP5 firmware is decompressed into it (up to 0x40000 bytes), so it must behave as RAM over the whole megabyte.
